main_h2: 事实部分 (周四 早 30 秒能懂)

Goldman Sachs ranked ByteDance's video-generation models above Zhipu' + 'A day before Goldman's coverage note, on July 8, Zhipu priced a $4 billion follow-on share sale at HK$1,588 to HK$1,698 per share, a discount of up to 13%'.
